set.body: Real MNI FIR comparison crops bilateral pial surfaces at default camera zoom. Source camera distance max(4,2*radius) ignores 35-degree FOV, whose half-angle admits less than the bounding sphere tangent angle. Reproduce through public SurfaceCompiler projected vertices across FOV, anatomical scale, mono/bilateral and viewpoints; fit canonical bounds without mutating geometry or silently resetting saved camera state. Consumer plsneuro bd-01M1Y8ANBY8P81GMXSFAB4QN4B, screenshots /private/tmp/plsneuro-brain-modes-2/compare.png. Existing aspect-ratio repair remains distinct.
